Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_buffer VARCHAR2(10);
Begin
 temp_buffer := :s_customer_id;
 select name into :s_customer_name from customers
 where customer_id = temp_buffer
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and substr(customer_id,5,2)!='PA'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 select customer_id, name into
 :s_customer_id, :s_customer_name
 from customers
 where customer_id = temp_buffer
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and substr(customer_id,5,2)!='PA'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 select customer_id, name into
 :s_customer_id, :s_customer_name
 from customers
 where upper(name) like
 (temp_buffer || '%')
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and substr(customer_id,5,2)!='PA'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 exception
 when too_many_rows then
 :s_customer_id := temp_buffer;
 :s_customer_name := null;
 list_values;
 when no_data_found then
 show_error_dist('0302');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then null;
 end;
 when too_many_rows then
 :s_customer_id := temp_buffer;
 :s_customer_name := null;
 list_values;
 when others then null;
 end;
 when others then null;
end;
nullchk;
NEXT_ITEM;
